name: Ferienwohnungen Lederer
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnungen Lederer are located in the district of Söll in the Sölllandl, one of the sunniest regions of Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the Kitzbühler Alpen and the Brixental with numerous hiking and cycling trails. The accommodation offers a quiet atmosphere and a good starting point for outdoor activities. In summer, hikes up the Hohe Salve or tours along the Brixenbach are enticing. In winter, the ski areas SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental and Kitzbühel are easily accessible and offer a variety of slopes. The center of Söll is within walking distance and offers places to stop for refreshments.
